agent_a_row.clinical_trial_sponsor: Wyeth is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pfizer
agent_a_row.clinical_trial_responsible_party: Wyeth is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pfizer
agent_a_row.outcome_overview_description: GMC as measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for 7 common pneumococcal serotypes (serotypes 4, 6B, 9V, 14, 18C, 19F, and 23F) and 6 additional pneumococcal serotypes specific to 13vPnC (Serotypes 1, 3, 5, 6A, 7F, and 19A) are presented. GMCs (13vPnC) were calculated for each pneumococcal serotype and timepoint, and 2-sided, 95% CI were constructed.
agent_a_row.outcome_overview_time_frame: One month after infant series dose 2 (at 5 months of age) and dose 3 (at 7 months of age) and one month after the toddler dose (at 16 months of age)
